name: agent-skills
description: Generic specialist skills and agents (architecture, QA, UX/UI, docs, requirements, security, performance) and cheap offload workers that complement Superpowers and Playwright.

offload_policy.title: Offload table at session start
offload_policy.description: Loads the offload table (about 700 tokens) into the context at session start and after a compaction, so the main conversation delegates the right work to the cheap workers. Turn it off when your own CLAUDE.md or account instructions already hold the table.
